title: Home safety
description: Evaluating your living environment and lifestyle to recommend personalised modifications (e.g., grab rails, ramps), adaptive equipment, and strategies to enhance safety, accessibility, and independence.

title: Reaching your goals
description: Regain the activities that matter most to you — or imagine new ones — through personalised, goal-driven occupational therapy focused on restoring meaningful participation and improving your quality of life.

title: Equipment prescription
description: Recommending the right support for your needs — from small aids through to complex equipment such as wheelchairs, electric beds, and recliner chairs.

title: Dementia wellbeing
description: Providing specialist support to help individuals living with dementia participate in meaningful activities, while empowering carers and families with the skills to connect and engage with their loved ones.

title: Custom adaptive equipment
description: Handcrafted, personalised adaptive aids and equipment designed and sewn to meet each client's unique functional needs.
